title: CROSS+WALKRI Applicant-Facing Publication Schema (Applicant Cohort)
description: The artifact shown to applicants. Specifies the entry specification gate criteria, the public benefit mechanism, the access condition, the obligation mode, and the evidence requirements at each gate. This is the applicant-cohort artifact published at the Commit stage of CLEAR and used by applicants throughout List.

obligation_mode.description: What kind of obligation this round creates. Determines which entry gate logic applies.

public_benefit_mechanism.description: The mechanism by which the round produces public benefit. Each mechanism type constrains the minimum evidence scope required at completion.

entry_specification_gate_criteria.description: The three required declarations at the entry specification gate plus any round-specific additional pre-conditions.

entry_gate_evidence.description: What evidence applicants must submit at entry.

completion_gate_evidence.description: What evidence is required at completion. Must satisfy the mechanism-evidence scope alignment for the declared mechanism type.

x-cross-walkri-primitive: Independent Verifiability from Sources Outside the Applicant's Control (Layer 1)
evidence_requirements.x-cross-walkri-source-section: WALKRI Section 3; Primitives Foundation v0.1.6 Layer 1
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence requirements at entry and completion gates with the independent verification source named per Commitment 6.

applicable_lens_metadata.description: Lens metadata exposed to applicants so they know which tier the round operates at and what scope type the framework occupies.
